integrity: The general statements are supported by explicit combinatorial proofs. Finite exhaustive computation is used only as independent corroboration of the inverse construction, formulas, and boundary cases.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to exactly one duplication with transposition whose duplicated block has length one. It does not cover longer duplicated blocks, repeated operations, noisy variants, code optima, or root-distance asymptotics.
title: Exact inverse branching for one-symbol duplication with transposition
